verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never says device posture (managed, encrypted, screen-locked) is checked in an SSO or auth policy before an app session is granted. The closest items are device-management security policies built on device attributes (docs-6) and access provisioning or revocation driven by role changes, risk signals and company policy (docs-1). These are adjacent controls for device configuration and lifecycle access, not a sign-in-time device-trust gate.

support.subject: As a security engineer, only healthy devices get in — device posture (managed, encrypted, screen-locked) is checked in the auth policy before an app session is granted
